_note: Text for the landing page, the self-service page and the licence page. A plain data file, so a translator can edit it without touching the build, and all three implementations read the same file. Relationship-type labels are NOT here, because they are canonical and come from contract/relationship-types.json, so the same relationship reads the same way regardless of which organisation issued it. Every locale other than English is machine-drafted and MUST be reviewed by a native speaker before production.
